name: raging-skills
description: A collection of high-quality plugins for .NET development, architecture, event sourcing, diagrams, and skill development. Curated by Sérgio Silveira with a focus on expert-level skills and practical utility. Explore plugins for C# coding, Akka.NET, KurrentDB, Mermaid diagrams, excalidraw generation, domain-driven design, and more. Each plugin includes comprehensive skills and commands to enhance your Claude Code experience.
